selectedModelBalancedCvRmsLogResidual.definition: pooled raw-log RMS over exactly one out-of-fold prediction for every eligible row from the five balanced folds
selectedModelBalancedCvRmsLogResidual.reason: avoid repeated row weighting and remove an output-sensitive ambiguity before fit

nearestEligibleLabelTie.uncertaintyRule: use maximum totalTrainingSigmaLog among exactly tied nearest eligible labels
nearestEligibleLabelTie.reason: row ordering must never select a smaller uncertainty
